summary: controller profile with jog, pad, fader, eq, audio, usb, media, display diagnostic groups. Companion workflow(s): Engine DJ,standalone.
identityNotes: Research seed with conservative, capability-dependent tests. Exact MIDI IDs, USB IDs, revision, OS support, audio channel maps and tolerance limits are NOT verified; learn or confirm on real hardware before giving pass/fail based on fixed specifications. This entry is PRIME GO+, not original PRIME GO; these units differ in Ethernet, streaming support, processor and battery life.

tests.title: Jog rotation and touch
tests.why: Check jog function on PRIME GO+; avoid assumptions about HID or analog routing.
steps: Consult the exact PRIME GO+ manual for the relevant connectors and operating mode.
Exercise each jog element on the device and observe MIDI, HID/software response or audio measurement as applicable.
Check slow and fast transitions, all channels/sides, and repeats; save raw evidence and mark unobservable functions as not tested.
equipment: Compatible host software or capture interface when required

tests.title: Firmware and application compatibility
tests.why: Prevent mismatched firmware and software versions from being reported as hardware failure.
steps: Read installed firmware and hardware revision.
Compare with the model-specific official compatibility and downloads pages.
Record operating system, application version, firmware and documentation URL.

tests.title: Battery and offline playback
steps: Run on fully charged internal battery with external power disconnected.
Play reference tracks from local storage on both decks and observe output stability.
Record measured run time and battery condition as user evidence, not manufacturer guarantee.

tests.title: PRIME GO+ Bluetooth and wireless routing
steps: Verify compatible Bluetooth input and output behavior.
Test Wi-Fi streaming only with an available supported service account.
Record Engine OS revision and confirm absence of built-in Ethernet port.
